models_evaluated: 15 LLM versions (families incl. Llama and Grok)

links.outcome: LLM PCI decision performance across age subgroups (age cut-points)
links.effect: Holm-adjusted analysis found significant performance gaps at age cut-points 73, 75, and 76; significant age-score interaction (LRT p = 0.00089) showed patient age modulates model performance.
links.quote: A significant age-score interaction (LRT p = 0.00089) confirmed that patient age modulates model performance.

unlisted_practices: Grouped/adaptive ensembling of multiple LLMs to improve decision accuracy (F1 0.921 vs 0.807 best single model)
Evaluating LLM performance under hierarchical levels of input data completeness

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of 15 LLMs and development/evaluation of an ensemble model for PCI clinical decision support, focusing on diagnostic/recommendation accuracy and algorithmic calibration rather than deployment practices.
